title: Return Reason Addition on the Early-Closure Returned-Fee Relief - Credit Builder Accounts
content:
The relief share of the early-closure returned-fee relief on a Credit Builder account depends on the return code of the account's most recent returned payment, as shown on its return line.

## Return codes

When the return code is R09 (uncollected funds), the uncollected-funds addition is added; when it is R01 (insufficient funds), the funds addition; for any other fee-bearing code nothing is added for the return reason.

| Return code of the most recent returned payment | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| R09, uncollected funds | uncollected-funds addition: 0.15 (15 percentage points) |
| R01, insufficient funds | funds addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| R02, R03, R04, R08, R16 or R20 | 0.0, nothing added |
